entries.definition: A precise sequence of rules for solving a problem

entries.definition: A collection of recorded facts or observations
entries.source_definition: a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn

entries.definition: The act of assigning things to categories
entries.source_definition: the act of distributing things into classes or categories of the same type

entries.definition: Statistical modelling of a response in relation to explanatory variables

entries.definition: A simplified representation of a system or process
entries.source_definition: a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process

entries.definition: An attribute used to describe an observation
entries.source_definition: a prominent attribute or aspect of something

entries.definition: The grouping of similar observations
entries.source_definition: a grouping of a number of similar things

entries.definition: An estimate of an unknown or future outcome
entries.source_definition: the act of predicting (as by reasoning about the future)

entries.definition: Closeness of a result to the correct or true value
entries.source_definition: the quality of being near to the true value

entries.definition: A security system that filters traffic between computers or networks

entries.definition: The conversion of readable information into coded form
entries.source_definition: the activity of converting data or information into code

entries.definition: Software designed to harm, disrupt or compromise a computer system
entries.source_definition: malicious software, designed to break into a system

entries.definition: A secret word or phrase used to help control access
entries.source_definition: a secret word or phrase known only to a restricted group

entries.definition: The process of checking a claimed identity or origin
entries.source_definition: validating the authenticity of something or someone

entries.definition: Malicious software that blocks access and demands payment
entries.source_definition: malicious software that makes a computer unusable unless a payment is made to the attacker

entries.definition: A method for transforming a message into a secret form
entries.source_definition: a secret method of writing

entries.definition: A separate copy of stored data kept for recovery
entries.source_definition: (computer science) a copy of a file or directory on a separate storage device

entries.definition: The practice of protecting information through codes and ciphers
entries.source_definition: act of writing in code or cipher

entries.definition: An interconnected system of devices or other components
entries.source_definition: an interconnected system of things or people

entries.definition: The conversion of coded information back into readable form
entries.source_definition: the activity of making clear or converting from code into plain text

entries.definition: A weakness that leaves a system susceptible to attack
entries.source_definition: susceptibility to injury or attack

entries.definition: Power obtained from moving air
entries.source_definition: power derived from the wind (as by windmills)

entries.source_definition: rotary engine in which the kinetic energy of a moving fluid is converted into mechanical energy by causing a bladed rotor to rotate

entries.definition: A machine that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy
entries.source_definition: engine that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy by electromagnetic induction

entries.definition: A device of one or more cells that supplies electrical energy
entries.source_definition: a device that produces electricity; may have several primary or secondary cells arranged in parallel or series

entries.definition: Plant material or animal waste used as fuel
entries.source_definition: plant materials and animal waste used as fuel

entries.definition: A device that converts direct current into alternating current
entries.source_definition: an electrical converter that converts direct current into alternating current

entries.definition: Energy supplied by the movement of electric charge
entries.source_definition: energy made available by the flow of electric charge through a conductor

entries.definition: A device that converts sunlight directly into electrical energy
entries.source_definition: a cell that converts solar energy into electrical energy

entries.definition: A mill driven by the wind
entries.source_definition: a mill that is powered by the wind

entries.definition: A physical quantity measured in joules and associated with the ability to do work
entries.source_definition: (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work; the units of energy are joules or ergs

entries.definition: The rotating part of a motor or generator
entries.source_definition: the rotating armature of a motor or generator

entries.definition: A programmable machine that carries out actions automatically
entries.source_definition: a mechanism that can move automatically

entries.definition: A device that detects and responds to a physical signal
entries.source_definition: any device that receives a signal or stimulus (as heat or pressure or light or motion etc.) and responds to it in a distinctive manner

entries.definition: A mechanism that produces movement or other action in a machine
entries.source_definition: a mechanism that puts something into automatic action

entries.source_definition: control system that converts a small mechanical motion into one requiring much greater power; may include a negative feedback system

entries.definition: The return of part of a system's output to regulate its input
entries.source_definition: the process in which part of the output of a system is returned to its input in order to regulate its further output

entries.definition: The use of technology to control equipment with reduced human intervention
entries.source_definition: the act of implementing the control of equipment with advanced technology; usually involving electronic hardware

entries.definition: A mechanism that regulates the operation of a machine
entries.source_definition: a mechanism that controls the operation of a machine

entries.source_definition: machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion

entries.definition: The study of motion without considering its forces or masses
entries.source_definition: the branch of mechanics concerned with motion without reference to force or mass

entries.definition: A connection where separate mechanical parts are joined
entries.source_definition: junction by which parts or objects are joined together

entries.definition: A projecting machine part resembling a human upper limb
entries.source_definition: any projection that is thought to resemble a human arm

entries.definition: The study and practical use of programmable machines
entries.source_definition: the area of AI concerned with the practical use of robots

packs.definition: Earth structure and plate movement vocabulary

entries.definition: The outermost solid layer of Earth
entries.source_definition: the outer layer of the Earth

entries.definition: The layer of Earth between its crust and core
entries.source_definition: the layer of the earth between the crust and the core

entries.definition: A rigid piece of Earth's lithosphere that moves relative to other pieces
entries.source_definition: a rigid layer of the Earth's crust that is believed to drift slowly

entries.definition: The movement of one tectonic plate down beneath another
entries.source_definition: a geological process in which one edge of a crustal plate is forced sideways and downward into the mantle below another plate

entries.definition: A fracture in rock along which displacement has occurred
entries.source_definition: (geology) a crack in the earth's crust resulting from the displacement of one side with respect to the other

entries.definition: Shaking of Earth's surface caused by a sudden release of energy
entries.source_definition: shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane or from volcanic activity

entries.definition: A vent through which molten rock and gases reach a planetary surface
entries.source_definition: a fissure in the earth's crust (or in the surface of some other planet) through which molten lava and gases erupt

entries.definition: A narrow fissure or opening in rock
entries.source_definition: a narrow fissure in rock

entries.definition: Molten rock beneath Earth's surface
entries.source_definition: molten rock in the earth's crust

entries.definition: Molten rock that has reached a planetary surface
entries.source_definition: rock that in its molten form (as magma) issues from volcanoes; lava is what magma is called when it reaches the surface

entries.definition: The study of deformation and large structures of Earth's crust
entries.source_definition: the branch of geology studying the folding and faulting of the earth's crust

entries.definition: One of Earth's large landmasses
entries.source_definition: one of the large landmasses of the earth

entries.definition: A hereditary sequence that contributes to a functional RNA or protein product
entries.source_definition: (genetics) a segment of DNA that is involved in producing a polypeptide chain; it can include regions preceding and following the coding DNA as well as introns between the exons; it is considered a unit of heredity

entries.definition: A structure of DNA and associated proteins that carries genes
entries.source_definition: a threadlike strand of DNA in the cell nucleus that carries the genes in a linear order

entries.definition: An organism's complete set of genetic material
entries.source_definition: the ordering of genes in a haploid set of chromosomes of a particular organism; the full DNA sequence of an organism

entries.definition: An alternative form of a gene at a particular locus
entries.source_definition: (genetics) either of a pair (or series) of alternative forms of a gene that can occupy the same locus on a particular chromosome and that control the same character

entries.definition: A change in a genetic sequence
entries.source_definition: (genetics) any event that changes genetic structure; any alteration in the inherited nucleic acid sequence of the genotype of an organism

entries.definition: The transmission of biological characteristics between generations
entries.source_definition: the biological process whereby genetic factors are transmitted from one generation to the next

entries.definition: The combination of alleles at specified genetic loci
entries.source_definition: the particular alleles at specified loci present in an organism

entries.definition: Observable characteristics arising from genes and the environment
entries.source_definition: what an organism looks like as a consequence of the interaction of its genotype and the environment

entries.definition: Cell division that reduces the chromosome number by half
entries.source_definition: (genetics) cell division that produces reproductive cells in sexually reproducing organisms; the nucleus divides into four nuclei each containing half the chromosome number (leading to gametes in animals and spores in plants)

entries.definition: Nuclear division that normally preserves the chromosome number
entries.source_definition: cell division in which the nucleus divides into nuclei containing the same number of chromosomes

entries.definition: A basic molecular building block of DNA or RNA
entries.source_definition: a phosphoric ester of a nucleoside; the basic structural unit of nucleic acids (DNA or RNA)

entries.definition: The branch of biology concerned with heredity and variation
entries.source_definition: the branch of biology that studies heredity and variation in organisms

packs.definition: Cricket sport vocabulary, excluding the insect meaning

entries.definition: The club used to strike the ball in cricket
entries.source_definition: the club used in playing cricket

entries.definition: The round object delivered by the bowler in cricket
entries.source_definition: round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games

entries.definition: A set of three stumps topped by two bails in cricket
entries.source_definition: cricket equipment consisting of a set of three stumps topped by crosspieces; used in playing cricket

entries.definition: The cricket player who delivers the ball to the batter
entries.source_definition: a cricketer who delivers the ball to the batsman in cricket

entries.definition: A batting turn of a cricket player or team
entries.source_definition: the batting turn of a cricket player or team

entries.definition: A set of six valid deliveries by one cricket bowler
entries.source_definition: (cricket) the division of play during which six balls are bowled at the batsman by one player from the other team from the same end of the pitch

entries.definition: One of the three upright posts forming a cricket wicket
entries.source_definition: (cricket) any of three upright wooden posts that form the wicket

entries.definition: An athlete who plays the bat-and-ball sport with eleven players per side
entries.source_definition: an athlete who plays cricket

entries.definition: A leg-spinner's delivery that turns in the opposite direction to the usual leg break
entries.source_definition: a cricket ball bowled as if to break one way that actually breaks in the opposite way

entries.definition: A cricket player on the side trying to stop runs and take wickets
entries.source_definition: a member of the cricket team that is fielding rather than batting

entries.definition: A batter's score of zero in cricket
entries.source_definition: (cricket) a score of nothing by a batsman

entries.definition: A second consecutive innings required of a trailing cricket team under the rules
entries.source_definition: an immediate second innings forced on a cricket team scoring a prescribed number of runs fewer than its opponents in the first innings

entries.definition: A cell specialised for transmitting nerve signals
entries.source_definition: a cell that is specialized to conduct nerve impulses

entries.definition: A nerve cell extension that usually carries signals away from its body
entries.source_definition: long nerve fiber that conducts away from the cell body of the neuron

entries.definition: A branching nerve cell extension that commonly receives signals
entries.source_definition: short fiber that conducts toward the cell body of the neuron

entries.definition: A junction through which a neuron communicates with another cell
entries.source_definition: the junction between two neurons (axon-to-dendrite) or between a neuron and a muscle

entries.definition: The outer layer of grey matter of the cerebrum
entries.source_definition: the layer of unmyelinated neurons (the grey matter) forming the cortex of the cerebrum

entries.definition: A brain region important for coordination and motor learning
entries.source_definition: a major division of the vertebrate brain; situated above the medulla oblongata and beneath the cerebrum in humans

entries.definition: A brain structure with a central role in forming memories
entries.source_definition: a complex neural structure (shaped like a sea horse) consisting of grey matter and located on the floor of each lateral ventricle; intimately involved in motivation and emotion as part of the limbic system; has a central role in the formation of memories

entries.definition: A bundle of fibres carrying signals through the body
entries.source_definition: any bundle of nerve fibers running to various organs and tissues of the body

entries.definition: The part of the central nervous system enclosed by the skull
entries.source_definition: that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord

entries.definition: A fatty insulating material surrounding many nerve fibres
entries.source_definition: a white fatty substance that forms a medullary sheath around the axis cylinder of some nerve fibers

entries.definition: The long central nervous structure linking the brain with many body nerves
entries.source_definition: a major part of the central nervous system which conducts sensory and motor nerve impulses to and from the brain; a long tubelike structure extending from the base of the brain through the vertebral canal to the upper lumbar region

entries.definition: The large upper brain region divided into two hemispheres
entries.source_definition: anterior portion of the brain consisting of two hemispheres; dominant part of the brain in humans
